what_changed_from_dev_seq_1.window_binding: DEV-SEQ-1 keyed a visible-feature card by series UID and kept the first construction window's card, so every u8 Episode was described to Slow, and scored by the validator, with u7's features.  A card is now keyed by (series_uid, origin) and a missing window is a recorded miss, never a borrowed card
what_changed_from_dev_seq_1.measurement_dedup: DEV-SEQ-1's L3 iterated group members, so one real reading cited by two Episodes of the same series and program counted twice.  A measurement is now keyed by the prediction cache's own key plus the served UID; no Episode is deleted and a different window, program, parameter set or training config stays a separate measurement
what_changed_from_dev_seq_1.model: DEV-SEQ-1 requested deepseek-chat, which this relay answers as deepseek-v4-flash.  This package fixes on gpt-5.6-sol and checks the returned identity, not the requested alias.  That makes it a different experiment from DEV-SEQ-1 and the two are not tabled together

q1b_dev_seq1_l2_recomputed.verdict: the refusal was not an artefact of the mis-binding: with each failing decision tested against its own window's features the predicate still covers 2 of 7, so L2 still fails.  This is reported to separate 'the old L2 rejected it' from 'there was no useful condition'; it is not a reason to approve the old card, which stays unadopted and is not re-run here

what_it_changed.text: Public evidence on this card shows two forecast decisions with missing_fraction above 0.5, longest_missing_run_fraction above 0.05, and local_robust_z_peak above 3 where outlier_mad did not retain a favorable evaluated result; no matched success has missing_fraction above 0.443878. These features describe the whole observed history rather than the serving window, so this separation is cautionary rather than proof. Mechanism hypothesis: when more than half of the history is missing, the robust-deviation summary may be unstable or unrepresentative of actionable serving-window corruption, allowing an intrinsic outlier repair to target apparent deviations without sufficient public evidence of benefit. In matching contexts, keep missingness and extreme deviation as separate hypotheses and do not treat a high robust-z peak alone as justification for outlier_mad. When no independently justified candidate is supported by current public evidence and verification, explicitly select identity. Preserve the existing candidate workflow and outlier handling outside this narrow applicability condition.

effect: For matching contexts lacking independent public support for a repair, identity selection is expected to leave all serving-window points unchanged.
Contexts outside the narrow high-missingness applicability condition are expected to retain the existing effective behavior.
falsified_by: The mechanism hypothesis is refuted if repeated evaluations of matching contexts show that outlier_mad, when selected from current public evidence and verification, consistently retains favorable support and delayed measurements relative to identity.
The edit should be withdrawn if it changes candidate selection outside its observable applicability condition or suppresses an independently justified effect-distinct candidate.

g1.what_is_still_a_guess: the mechanism.  The card carries facts -- programs, windows, both faces, the visible features of failures and of matched successes -- and the edit is one provisional account of them. Nothing in this package establishes that account is the cause; only the two arms say whether acting on it helped

L2_detail.counted_by: distinct (series_uid, window) decisions, each tested against its own window's features -- DEV-SEQ-1 tested every member against the first window that series appeared in

coverage_diagnostic_not_a_gate.status: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY.  These lines describe the predicate's coverage.  They do not gate adoption in this package, because coverage is not the same question as whether the guidance changes what Fast does and helps

what_it_changed.text: When forecast evidence shows both substantial missingness and a strong local robust deviation, inspect the missingness and deviation regions separately. Treat a broad or uncertain deviation span as insufficient public evidence for an outlier repair, because the observed negative cases include missing_fraction above 0.4 and local_robust_z_peak above 5 while the same mechanism also has mixed outcomes elsewhere. Prefer a minimal localized program only when the inspected hypothesis has a legal verifiable binding; otherwise retain identity. Keep the existing behavior for cases without this combined evidence and for narrowly localized deviations with sufficient public support.

effect: For forecast contexts meeting the combined public-evidence condition, fewer broad outlier repairs should be selected when inspection cannot establish a localized, legally bound deviation hypothesis.
Contexts without the combined condition should preserve the existing inspection and candidate-selection behavior.
falsified_by: In subsequent matched contexts satisfying task_kind == forecast, missing_fraction >= 0.4, and local_robust_z_peak >= 5, the retrieved guidance does not increase explicit identity retention when the inspected deviation region is broad or uncertain.

The observed negative association disappears after additional public observations, or the guidance causes identity to be retained despite a consistently localized and verifiable deviation hypothesis with positive observed effects.

exposure.cost: zero Consumer fits, zero LLM calls
exposure.what_this_is_not: not a coverage gate.  It does not require the condition to explain most failures or to match a majority of anything.  It asks only whether the edit is presented to the decisions that are about to be paid for; a modification that is never on screen cannot be measured by running more of them
exposure.clause_reading: no single clause is empty here.  missing_fraction > 0.5 is satisfied by T14 at all three windows; longest_missing_run_fraction > 0.05 is satisfied by T146 and T16 and never by T14.  No series in the 60 arm decisions satisfies both, so the conjunction is empty.  The two missingness clauses were read off the same formation evidence -- at u7, T14 had missing_fraction 0.5655 and longest_missing_run_fraction 0.0689 together -- and they come apart on the arm windows.
exposure.population_correction: an earlier pass of this check ran on 10 sequences per unit rather than the registered 20: run_dev_seq2.population_for fetched the roster at the formation size and then sliced to the arm size, which silently capped the arm population whenever the arms were the wider of the two.  Fixed; this receipt is the corrected 20-per-unit reading and the earlier 0/30 receipt is superseded, not deleted.

behaviour_chain.why: no unit was run by both arms

exposure_split.how_to_read_this: the exposed rows are the only pairs where the two arms held different effective knowledge.  Every other pair ran under the same effective knowledge, so its difference is sampling: those are summarised as a spread measured inside this run.  It is descriptive, not a reliable noise floor, and the exposed rows are too few to average into a claim

main_delayed_readout.why_unknown: a missing required reading on either side makes the whole-population difference UNKNOWN; the readable subset is reported beside it, never in its place

behaviour_chain.how_to_read_it: only the first block can carry a knowledge effect: those are the pairs whose two arms held different effective knowledge.  The second block is the same five links on pairs whose arms held the SAME effective knowledge, so every difference in it is sampling. Reading the two together, or reading the second as an effect, is the mistake this split exists to prevent.  Within the first block the links still fail separately: loaded with no downstream difference means the text was read and not used.
